description:
to the exhibition Eleanor Antin. A retrospective
with Beate Frommelt

We take a close look at individual works of art in the current exhibitions and discuss them. Together with the artist Beate Frommelt, the participants then become active in the studio themselves. We try something different at every appointment.

No previous knowledge is required. Anyone and everyone is welcome! We are open to all ages from the age of 14 and up to a maximum of 10 people.

Beate Frommelt is experienced in working with young people, adults and people suffering from dementia.


time
2 p.m. to 4:30 p.m

As part of the free Wednesday, the offer is free of charge.


The events take place in collaboration with “Zemma tua – Seniors active together”. This program is coordinated by Dementia Liechtenstein.

The number of participants is limited, we ask you to register on +423 235 03 00 or directly via the website.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic «After Work Concert» Pure Percussion
description:
Pulsating rhythms, quick-witted virtuosity and sophisticated sounds: a concert for everyone who wants to leave everyday life behind them in a relaxed atmosphere after work.

Anyone who thinks of timpani and snare drums when they hear the term percussion will definitely be surprised this evening: the focus is on the marimba - an instrument with an expressive power that can best be described as voluminous resonance in all registers. At this after work concert, Christoph Sietzen and Bogdan Bacanu take the audience right into the heart of pulsating rhythms, quick-witted virtuosity and sophisticated sounds. The two artists have been making music together for many years. What they have in common is not only exceptional technical precision, but above all their playful lightness and great stage presence. “Pure Percussion” is a concert for the curious – for lovers of classical music as well as for everyone who wants to leave everyday life behind them in a relaxed atmosphere after work.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Night of the Opera” Nadine Sierra & Javier Camarena
location:
Generated BP name 1269721956120 (Lageplan)
Rathausplatz
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Take a seat, lean back and enjoy the most beautiful melodies from opera literature right in the heart of Liechtenstein.

On this summer evening, the Vaduz town hall square is transformed into an open-air opera stage - with a backdrop that no set designer in the world could create. Because as soon as the sun slowly disappears behind the mountains and the first notes are heard, the music unfolds its very special magic. Two of the most important opera stars of our time contribute to this: the soprano Nadine Sierra and the tenor Javier Camarena, who delight audiences at the world's major opera houses. After joint successes in Verdi's "La traviata" and Gounod's "Roméo et Juliette", they can now be experienced for the first time at VADUZ CLASSIC and give us an unforgettable evening with arias and duets full of passion, virtuosity and emotions. Look forward to a concert that touches, thrills and resonates for a long time. And if you shed a tear or two of emotion, you're in good company.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Masterpieces” Gautier Capuçon & Ensemble Capucelli
location:
Vaduzer Saal (Lageplan)
Giessenstrasse 7
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
This evening's musical menu includes French sophistication, Italian passion and a touch of Argentine melancholy.

A good menu does not depend on a single course, but on the successful composition. It surprises, arouses curiosity and unfolds its charm from aisle to aisle. It's the same with this concert. The Ensemble Capucelli serves a little bit of everything – although not on plates, but with seven cellos. With Gautier Capuçon and the Ensemble Capucelli, seven outstanding cellists will be on stage. The ensemble was created through Capuçon's commitment to promoting young talent and brings together former award winners of his support program. Together, the seven cellists develop an ensemble sound that is as homogeneous as it is colorful and impressively show how versatile the cello is - as a solo instrument, as a chamber music partner and as a sound body of almost orchestral fullness. Rossini's "William Tell", Tchaikovsky's "Waltz of the Flowers", Ravel's "Boléro" or Piazzolla's "La muerte del ángel" are heard in arrangements specially created for cello ensembles and open up new perspectives on well-known masterpieces. A concert full of sonic discoveries: varied, surprising and with a pinch of French elegance.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Classic meets Electro” with Catching Flies
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Café
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Catching Flies is a British multi-instrumentalist and DJ. With synthesizers and a string quartet, he transforms the café in the art museum into a mixture of nightclub and concert hall.

Behind the name “Catching Flies” is the British multi-instrumentalist, producer and DJ George King. His music moves effortlessly between electronic beats and acoustic sound worlds. Warm synthesizer sounds meet strings, finely interwoven rhythms meet catchy melodies. “Catching Flies” is known for its unmistakably warm and atmospheric sound. His tracks combine atmospheric electronics with complex rhythms and range from hip-hop to house to soul and jazz. Together with his British string quartet, he transforms the CAFE in the art museum into a mixture of urban nightclub and stylish concert hall. “Catching Flies” has impressively proven in recent years that this connection is much more than an exciting experiment. His recent highlights include a BBC Radio 1 Essential Mix, a live video with the string quartet for Anjunadeep, one of the most famous electronic music labels in the world, and a live performance of his track “Orsay” at the Musée d’Orsay in Paris. A concert to listen to, immerse yourself in and take part in: atmospherically dense and sonically sophisticated – the perfect soundtrack for a long festival night.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Family Concert” Igudesman & Landymore
location:
Generated BP name 1269721956120 (Lageplan)
Rathausplatz
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Chill & Thrill combines virtuosity, humor and improvisation. Aleksey Igudesman and Lucy Landymore surprise with Mozart and Latin American rhythms. A concert for the whole family.

The “Chill & Thrill” program delivers what the title promises. Virtuosity meets humor, improvisation meets sophisticated arrangements - and hardly a moment turns out the way you expect it. With Aleksey Igudesman you never know exactly what will happen next. One minute you're listening to the sounds of Mozart, but a few moments later Latin American rhythms create a South American spirit. Aleksey Igudesman has been one of the most original violinists and composers on the international music scene for many years. With his legendary duo Igudesman & Joo, he thrilled millions of audiences worldwide. Together with the British multi-instrumentalist, composer and percussionist Lucy Landymore, he is now presenting a program full of musical surprises. Own compositions alternate with sophisticated arrangements, quiet and atmospheric moments with virtuoso improvisations and rousing grooves. Laughter isn't always expected in concerts - but with Aleksey Igudesman and Lucy Landymore it's a given.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic – “Classic meets Jazz” with Till Brönner & Dieter Ilg
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Café
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Two musicians who don't need a grand gesture to fill a room: with trumpet and double bass, Brönner & Ilg transform the art museum into a stage for subtle dialogue and virtuoso playing.

A summer evening in Vaduz and two musicians who don't need a big gesture to fill a room: When Till Brönner and Dieter Ilg perform together, two characters meet who support, challenge and push each other forward. Both musicians share the ability to not only tell stories, but to create them in the moment. Sometimes it seems like a quiet conversation late in the evening, sometimes like a spontaneous improvisation that only takes shape during the game. They don't rush from climax to climax, but rather give the music time to breathe. It is precisely where music leaves space and is not filled every second that the greatest tension often arises. Miles Davis repeatedly emphasized that the unplayed notes in jazz have at least the same meaning as those actually played. «The hearing is apparently capable of thinking about what cannot be heard. And according to our experience and our feelings, that really stimulates the brain and the heart,” says Till Brönner. This is exactly what makes this duo so attractive. The music never seems overloaded or demonstrative, but rather clear, concentrated and open.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Hollywood in Vaduz” Hans Zimmer & John Williams
location:
Generated BP name 1269721956120 (Lageplan)
Rathausplatz
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
The Oscar and Golden Globe-winning conductor Ernst van Tiel will lead and moderate the most popular Hollywood melodies together with the Liechtenstein Symphony Orchestra and numerous star guests.

The 2026 festival edition ends with a big fanfare straight from Hollywood: Under the motto “Hollywood in Vaduz”, the final concert invites you to a spectacular open-air experience in the heart of Vaduz. The conductor Ernst van Tiel, who was awarded an "Oscar" and a "Golden Globe", moderates and leads, together with the Liechtenstein Symphony Orchestra and several star guests, through the most popular Hollywood melodies - from "Pirates of the Caribbean" to "Jurassic Park", "Star Wars", "Harry Potter", "E.T." and “Interstellar” to “Gladiator”. There is also an exceptional soloist on stage with the internationally sought-after drummer Aleksandra Šuklar. She is part of Hans Zimmer's touring ensemble and, together with other surprise guests, brings the unmistakable Hollywood sound to the stage - an experience full of exciting show moments. The production is atmospherically supported by a light show and festive lighting - an open-air experience for the whole family.
